record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace only the Transformer feed-forward GELU activation with SiLU, retaining pre-normalization, two blocks, existing heads, 2× feed-forward width and residual paths. SiLU's smooth gating may improve contextual item interactions without adding parameters or materially increasing computation. Preserve features, embedding parameterization, history/readout, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer to instantiate the same activation, loading one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Replace only GELU with SiLU in all four category models' Transformer feed-forward blocks. Smooth activation may improve contextual interactions while preserving dimensions, pre-normalization, residuals and parameter counts. The predictor writer already imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so inference automatically uses the matching activation and unchanged checkpoint shapes.
